title: 工業棕地風險評估~Industrial-brownfield risk assessment
focus: 將棕地歷史、採樣品質與暴露路徑轉為可檢查的風險概念模型~Turn brownfield history, sampling quality and exposure pathways into an auditable risk model
summary: 本課以「將棕地歷史、採樣品質與暴露路徑轉為可檢查的風險概念模型」為主軸，依序處理場址使用史與概念圖、空間異質性與採樣設計、介質濃度與接觸量、地下水途徑與遷移、不確定度與決策敏感度。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Turn brownfield history, sampling quality and exposure pathways into an auditable risk model, progressing through Site history and conceptual diagram, Spatial heterogeneity and sampling design, Media concentration and contact quantity, Groundwater pathway and migration, Uncertainty and decision sensitivity. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 場址使用史與概念圖~Site history and conceptual diagram
units.mechanism: 在虛構工業地圖標記儲槽、裝卸、排水與回填活動，先提出可被採樣推翻的污染假說。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。~Mark tanks, loading, drains and fill on a fictional industrial map and formulate contamination hypotheses that sampling can challenge. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽樣區域 A=10000 m²；每格面積 a=400 m²。公式 N=ceil(A/a)，計算得 25 sample cells。適用邊界：規則平面網格計數，未指定法規採樣密度或統計信賴。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.
units.verify: 針對「場址使用史與概念圖」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Site history and conceptual diagram, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「場址使用史與概念圖」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Site history and conceptual diagram flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 樣本平均值低就代表每個未採樣位置也都低。~A low sample mean proves every unsampled location is also low.
units.practice: 只將 a 改成 300 m²，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 25 變成 34 sample cells。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only cell area a to 300 m², holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 25 to 34 sample cells. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 污染源、途徑與受體~Source, pathway and receptor
units.mechanism: 為現況工人、鄰近居民與未來用途分開畫接觸路徑，未完整路徑仍需標明被切斷的依據。 介質濃度乘接觸量才形成暴露質量；受體行為與接觸路徑決定分析邊界。~Map pathways separately for workers, neighbours and future uses, documenting evidence where a pathway is incomplete. Media concentration multiplied by contact quantity gives exposure mass; receptor behaviour and pathway define the boundary.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土中 C=10 mg/kg；假想土壤接觸攝入量 I=50 mg/day。公式 intake=C*I/1e6，計算得 0.0005 mg/day。適用邊界：純單位換算的假想接觸例，未含生體可用率、體重或毒性；非個人健康評估。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Soil C=10 mg/kg; hypothetical soil ingestion contact I=50 mg/day. Formula intake=C*I/1e6 gives 0.0005 mg/day. Applicability: A hypothetical unit-conversion example without bioavailability, body mass or toxicity; not an individual health assessment.
units.verify: 針對「污染源、途徑與受體」，先畫出完整接觸路徑，再記錄接觸假設、活動時間與其依據，避免直接以濃度稱風險。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Source, pathway and receptor, Map a complete pathway before documenting contact assumptions, duration and evidence; do not call concentration alone risk. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 漏掉 mg 土壤轉 kg 的因子會產生百萬倍誤差。 在「污染源、途徑與受體」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Omitting the mg-to-kg soil conversion produces a million-fold error. Mark where this error can enter the Source, pathway and receptor flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 污染濃度相同就保證所有使用者的暴露量相同。~Equal contamination concentration guarantees equal exposure for all users.
units.practice: 只將 I 改成 100 mg/day，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.0005 變成 0.001 mg/day。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only I to 100 mg/day, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.0005 to 0.001 mg/day. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.mechanism: 結合規則網格與設備歷史的針對性採樣，將熱點調查與區域平均估計分成不同任務。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。~Combine grids with historically targeted samples and separate hotspot investigation from area-mean estimation. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.

units.title: 實驗室品質與平行樣~Laboratory assurance and duplicates
units.mechanism: 查核空白、保存時間、回收率和重複性，未達量測目的的資料需保留旗標。 平行樣相對百分差衡量重複性，不能單獨揭露共同系統偏差或整個場址異質性。~Check blanks, holding records, recovery and precision and flag data that do not meet the measurement objective. Relative percent difference measures duplicate precision but cannot alone reveal shared systematic bias or site-wide heterogeneity.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：平行樣 C1=18 mg/kg；C2=22 mg/kg。公式 RPD=abs(C1-C2)/((C1+C2)/2)*100，計算得 20 %。適用邊界：同基準且高於定量能力的正值；近零時比例不穩，無預設法定合格門檻。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Duplicate C1=18 mg/kg; C2=22 mg/kg. Formula RPD=abs(C1-C2)/((C1+C2)/2)*100 gives 20 %. Applicability: Positive values on the same basis above quantification capability; ratios become unstable near zero, with no assumed legal acceptance threshold.
units.verify: 針對「實驗室品質與平行樣」，搭配空白、加標回收和採樣位置檢查差異來自分析或現場不均。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Laboratory assurance and duplicates, Combine blanks, spikes and sample locations to separate analytical variation from field heterogeneity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 兩樣同受污染或同一校正偏差時，RPD 仍可很低。 在「實驗室品質與平行樣」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Two equally contaminated or equally miscalibrated samples can have a low RPD. Mark where this error can enter the Laboratory assurance and duplicates flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 兩個平行樣完全相同就證明結果一定準確。~Identical duplicates prove the result is accurate.
units.practice: 只將 C2 改成 26 mg/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變成 36.3636 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only C2 to 26 mg/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 20 to 36.3636 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 介質濃度與接觸量~Media concentration and contact quantity
units.mechanism: 逐項追蹤介質單位和接觸行為，避免將 mg/kg 土壤與 mg/kg 體重混為一談。 介質濃度乘接觸量才形成暴露質量；受體行為與接觸路徑決定分析邊界。~Track media units and contact assumptions carefully and distinguish mg/kg soil from mg/kg body mass. Media concentration multiplied by contact quantity gives exposure mass; receptor behaviour and pathway define the boundary.

Recalculation changes 0.0005 to 0.001 mg/day. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 篩選基準的適用範圍~Applicability of screening benchmarks
units.mechanism: 本題使用完全假想的比較基準；在真實調查必須另核對主管機關、介質、用途與時效。 篩選比值用於排序調查問題，基準必須對應受體、路徑與時間尺度。~This exercise uses a wholly hypothetical benchmark; real investigations require separate checks of authority, media, land use and currency. Screening ratios prioritize investigation; a benchmark must match receptor, pathway and duration.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：假想暴露濃度 C=0.02 mg/L；紙上比較基準 B=0.01 mg/L。公式 R=C/B，計算得 2 screening ratio。適用邊界：B 是明示假設而非健康或法規限值；比值不是個人疾病機率。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Hypothetical exposure concentration C=0.02 mg/L; paper comparison benchmark B=0.01 mg/L. Formula R=C/B gives 2 screening ratio. Applicability: B is an explicit teaching assumption, not a health or legal limit; the ratio is not an individual disease probability.
units.verify: 針對「篩選基準的適用範圍」，標記來源—途徑—受體及缺失資料，逐一確認濃度與基準的介質、單位和時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Applicability of screening benchmarks, Map source, pathway, receptor and data gaps; match media, units and durations between concentration and benchmark. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 跨介質或跨受體套用同一基準會製造錯誤安全感。 在「篩選基準的適用範圍」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Applying one benchmark across media or receptors creates false reassurance. Mark where this error can enter the Applicability of screening benchmarks flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 篩選比值小於 1 就能證明場址對所有人永遠沒有風險。~A screening ratio below one proves a site is risk-free for everyone forever.
units.practice: 只將 C 改成 0.008 mg/L，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 0.8 screening ratio。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only C to 0.008 mg/L, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2 to 0.8 screening ratio. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 地下水途徑與遷移~Groundwater pathway and migration
units.mechanism: 把源區與下游受體連結，加入地下水流速、吸附和不確定流路，避免用直線距離當抵達時間。 孔隙平均流速為 Darcy 通量除有效孔隙率；污染遲滯與彌散另需處理。~Connect sources with downgradient receptors while accounting for velocity, sorption and uncertain paths rather than distance alone. Mean pore-water velocity is Darcy flux divided by effective porosity; retardation and dispersion require separate treatment.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.
units.verify: 針對「地下水途徑與遷移」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Groundwater pathway and migration, Compare estimated velocity with tracer arrival, stratigraphy and heads, listing parameter ranges. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「地下水途徑與遷移」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Groundwater pathway and migration flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 地下水孔隙流速永遠等於水力傳導係數 K。~Pore-water velocity always equals hydraulic conductivity K.
units.practice: 只將 ne 改成 0.20，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.3456 變成 0.432 m/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only ne to 0.20, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.3456 to 0.432 m/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Recalculation changes 2 to 0.8 screening ratio. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 不確定度與決策敏感度~Uncertainty and decision sensitivity
units.mechanism: 對流量與濃度等量測建立不確定度示例，另外列出模型結構和未採樣熱點的不確定性。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。~Build an uncertainty example for flow and concentration while separately listing structural and unsampled-hotspot uncertainty. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
units.verify: 針對「不確定度與決策敏感度」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Uncertainty and decision sensitivity, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「不確定度與決策敏感度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Uncertainty and decision sensitivity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 重複量測次數越多，所有系統性誤差都會自動消失。~More repeats automatically eliminate every systematic error.
units.practice: 只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only uC to 0.03, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.072111 to 0.05 relative standard uncertainty. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 再利用交接與可追溯紀錄~Reuse handoff and traceable records
units.mechanism: 交付概念模型、採樣座標、原始報告和控制措施的維護責任；時間資料完整率僅示範證據可追溯性。 完整率追蹤有效資料覆蓋；缺值可能集中在尖峰事件，不能只看比例。~Handoff the conceptual model, sample locations, original reports and maintenance responsibilities; temporal completeness illustrates evidence traceability only. Completeness tracks valid coverage; gaps may cluster during peaks, so percentage alone is insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：應有時段 N=1440；有效時段 n=1320。公式 coverage=n/N*100，計算得 91.6667 %。適用邊界：明確時間格與有效性規則；本題不宣稱任何法規有效率門檻。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Expected intervals N=1440; valid intervals n=1320. Formula coverage=n/N*100 gives 91.6667 %. Applicability: Explicit interval grid and validity rules; no regulatory completeness threshold is claimed.
units.verify: 針對「再利用交接與可追溯紀錄」，畫出缺值時間軸並保留校正、維護與通訊錯誤旗標，禁止把缺值填成零。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Reuse handoff and traceable records, Plot missing intervals with calibration, maintenance and communication flags; never replace missing values with zero. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「再利用交接與可追溯紀錄」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Reuse handoff and traceable records flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 缺測資料填成零不會影響污染平均值。~Replacing missing data with zero does not affect mean pollution.
units.practice: 只將 n 改成 1200，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 91.6667 變成 83.3333 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only valid intervals n to 1200, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 91.6667 to 83.3333 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
